RESIDUAL_PROJECTIONS = ("o_proj.weight", "down.weight", "out_proj.weight")

class Alexnet(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 64, kernel_size=11, stride=4, padding=2, bias=True)
        self.pool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=0)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(64, 192, kernel_size=5, stride=1, padding=2, bias=True)
        self.pool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=0)
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(192, 384, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=True)
        self.conv4 = nn.Conv2d(384, 256, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=True)
        self.conv5 = nn.Conv2d(256, 256, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1, bias=True)
        self.pool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=0)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(9216, 4096, bias=True)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(4096, 4096, bias=True)
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(4096, 1000, bias=True)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def init_weights(self):
        """Normal(0, 0.02), with residual projections scaled by depth.

        PyTorch's defaults leave nn.Embedding at a unit normal, which starts
        a language model near a cross-entropy of a few hundred rather than
        ln(vocab). Call this after moving the model to its device.
        """
        for module in self.modules():
            if isinstance(module, (nn.Linear, nn.Embedding)):
                nn.init.normal_(module.weight, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
                bias = getattr(module, "bias", None)
                if bias is not None:
                    nn.init.zeros_(bias)
        for name, param in self.named_parameters():
            if name.endswith(RESIDUAL_PROJECTIONS):
                nn.init.normal_(param, mean=0.0, std=0.014142136)
        return self

    def forward(self, ids):
        conv1_y = F.relu(self.conv1(ids))
        pool1_y = self.pool1(conv1_y)
        conv2_y = F.relu(self.conv2(pool1_y))
        pool2_y = self.pool2(conv2_y)
        conv3_y = F.relu(self.conv3(pool2_y))
        conv4_y = F.relu(self.conv4(conv3_y))
        conv5_y = F.relu(self.conv5(conv4_y))
        pool3_y = self.pool3(conv5_y)
        flatten_y = torch.flatten(pool3_y, 1)
        fc1_y = self.fc1(flatten_y)
        act1_y = F.relu(fc1_y)
        fc2_y = self.fc2(act1_y)
        act2_y = F.relu(fc2_y)
        fc3_y = self.fc3(act2_y)
        return fc3_y

    actual = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
